verdicts.reason: Dump 1280.json holds span.nav-badge text "2" on the お知らせ item, and the 1280 screenshot shows badge 2, the 対応が必要な項目 row 「要対応のお知らせ 2件」, and an 未読のお知らせ list of 3 notices with only one carrying the 要対応 tag. Bundle index-DKXolRs7.js shows the badge is rendered with aria-label `${badgeLabel ?? 未読}${badge}件` and the お知らせ item sets badgeLabel:`要対応`, so the badge is intentionally a 要対応 count (assistive tech hears 要対応2件) and is not wrong data. Part that holds: sighted users get a bare "2" with no visible label next to a 3-item unread list, so the meaning is ambiguous. Part that overreaches: it is not untrue copy, since the 要対応 count may legitimately include notices outside the 未読 list. severity_suggestion: NOTE
